title: Audio Ecosystem, API, License & Authority Survey

future_start_resolution: freshly verify current provider APIs, SDKs, terms, account and entitlement requirements, licensing and technical capability before implementation decisions
survey user-owned local audio plus current external provider candidates including Syrinscape, TableTone, PocketBard and Tabletop Audio without assuming any provider is canonical or complete

record capability evidence for catalog/search, authentication, entitlement, native/embedded/external playback, session control, soundset or preset control, one-shots, layered mixing, per-layer volume, remote synchronization, caching, export, attribution and recording/streaming permissions
define fail-closed handling for unsupported, unknown, unavailable, entitlement-denied and license-restricted capabilities rather than emulating them through scraping or prohibited copying
preserve separation between semantic audio intent and selected provider asset/reference
define authority boundaries proving audio remains presentation/support state and never becomes World, Event, Combat or other gameplay truth
define evidence/provenance requirements for provider references, user-owned files, entitlement, license and capability claims
resolve the exact AAI-01 deliverables, verifier and acceptance contract before creating an implementation branch
selection_contract.authority_rule: Selection authorizes planning resolution only. It does not authorize provider integration code, provider accounts, authentication, downloads, caching, copying, redistribution, purchases, subscriptions, payment, scraping or implementation branches.
selection_contract.provider_rule: Commercial provider audio remains controlled or referenced through legitimate entitlement unless an explicit license permits local ingestion; unsupported capabilities remain unsupported.
selection_contract.owner_rule: AAI may describe and later control audio presentation, but audio cannot create or replace canonical World/Event/Combat/Scene/gameplay truth.

preserved_boundaries: MAI-01..10 are completed_verified with no further MAI implementation authority
AAI-01 is selected_not_started with no implementation branch or authority
audio intent remains separate from provider asset identity
no provider/catalog is canonical and no provider is assumed to support every capability
missing or disabled audio never blocks play
hidden or GM-only cue metadata remains permission-scoped
recording, streaming, caching, export, attribution and redistribution permissions must be explicit rather than inferred
no provider acquisition/download/authentication/scraping/payment, tester distribution, release/deployment or real-money activation is authorized by selection
next_action: Selection only. On the next owner Continue, freshly verify then-current AIOC/application heads and current external provider/API/terms/license/entitlement facts, resolve the exact AAI-01 survey evidence and authority contract, and only then governed-start AAI-01. Until then do not create an implementation branch or provider integration.
